quotedPost.originalText:
I open-sourced the skill from this experiment: jev-browser-skill.

Your coding agent needs to find a page on an unfamiliar site? Give it this skill.

It opens isolated Chromium, starts at the URL you give it, and clicks through until it reaches the target.

You write the goal. Jev navigates.

Works with Codex, Claude Code, and any coding agent that supports skills.

https://t.co/wbHPLTIzD3

post.originalText:
wtf, Opus 5.5 is insane at making videos.

Tried it for my open-source project, jev-browser-skill. The visuals blew me away. Even the background music is good.

The prompt:
"Make a dynamic 20-second motion graphics launch video for my open-source project jev-browser-skill ('Give a site. Write a goal. Jev clicks.'), like it's the hero video on its GitHub README. Go all out."
